quotes.text: human rights are women's rights and women's rights are human rights, once and for all.
quotes.source: Remarks to the UN Fourth World Conference on Women, Beijing, 5 Sep 1995

quotes.text: If there is one message that echoes forth from this conference, let it be that human rights are women's rights . . . . And women's rights are human rights, once and for all.
quotes.source: Remarks to the UN Fourth World Conference on Women, Beijing, 5 Sep 1995

quotes.text: It is time for us to say here in Beijing, and the world to hear, that it is no longer acceptable to discuss women's rights as separate from human rights.
quotes.source: Remarks to the UN Fourth World Conference on Women, Beijing, 5 Sep 1995

quotes.text: The great challenge of this conference is to give voice to women everywhere whose experiences go unnoticed, whose words go unheard.
quotes.source: Remarks to the UN Fourth World Conference on Women, Beijing, 5 Sep 1995

quotes.text: Those of us who have the opportunity to be here have the responsibility to speak for those who could not.
quotes.source: Remarks to the UN Fourth World Conference on Women, Beijing, 5 Sep 1995

quotes.text: These abuses have continued because, for too long, the history of women has been a history of silence.
quotes.source: Remarks to the UN Fourth World Conference on Women, Beijing, 5 Sep 1995

quotes.text: Let us not forget that among those rights are the right to speak freely. And the right to be heard.
quotes.source: Remarks to the UN Fourth World Conference on Women, Beijing, 5 Sep 1995

quotes.text: Every woman deserves the chance to realize her God-given potential.
quotes.source: Remarks to the UN Fourth World Conference on Women, Beijing, 5 Sep 1995

quotes.text: What we are learning around the world is that, if women are healthy and educated, their families will flourish.
quotes.source: Remarks to the UN Fourth World Conference on Women, Beijing, 5 Sep 1995

quotes.text: We need to understand that there is no one formula for how women should lead their lives.
quotes.source: Remarks to the UN Fourth World Conference on Women, Beijing, 5 Sep 1995

quotes.text: That is why we must respect the choices that each woman makes for herself and her family.
quotes.source: Remarks to the UN Fourth World Conference on Women, Beijing, 5 Sep 1995

quotes.text: Let this conference be our — and the world's — call to action.
quotes.source: Remarks to the UN Fourth World Conference on Women, Beijing, 5 Sep 1995

quotes.text: And to all the little girls who are watching this, never doubt that you are valuable and powerful and deserving of every chance and opportunity in the world to pursue and achieve your own dreams.

quotes.text: Our constitutional democracy enshrines the peaceful transfer of power and we don’t just respect that, we cherish it.

quotes.text: I know how disappointed you feel, because I feel it, too.
